## Overview

- **Name**: PostgreSQL Database
- **Description**: Relational datastore holding all Odoo ORM models and business data.
- **Type**: Database
- **Class**: Stateful
- **Technology**: PostgreSQL 16
- **Deployment**: Docker Compose service (`postgres:16` image, single replica)
- **Source**: External (managed image; image: `postgres:16`)
- **Inferred?**: No — mapped from IaC

## Purpose

Persists every Odoo model table (including upstream `sale_order`) for the Odoo Application Server. It exists as a separate unit so data survives application container rebuilds via the `pg-data` named volume. It is not published to the host; only containers on the compose network can reach it. The custom credit-limit addon adds only non-stored computed fields to `sale_order`, so it introduces no new tables or columns here.
